# Query to compare goal percentage of wrist shots for Montreal and Toronto in the 2020-21 season
sql_query = """
SELECT 
    t1.team_id,
    t1.team_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.event_type = 'goal' THEN 1 END) AS goals,
    COUNT(*) AS total_shots,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.event_type = 'goal' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS goal_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s.team_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN s.team_id = 8 THEN 'Montreal'
            WHEN s.team_id = 10 THEN 'Toronto'
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS team_name,
        s.event_type,
        s.shot_type
    FROM table_044b1ed43483ebcc02fb4a21ed4e5b9c s
    WHERE s.season = '20202021'
      AND s.shot_type = 'wrist'
      AND (s.team_id = 8 OR s.team_id = 10)
) t1
GROUP BY t1.team_id, t1.team_name
ORDER BY t1.team_name;
"""
